notes:
Streams from sites that limit download speed (429) now finish: Torrio slows down and continues instead of failing
Streams locked to your IP retry over IPv6 automatically
Clearer messages when a site refuses a download or a link has expired
Your download list and history are kept safe: a damaged file is never replaced by an empty one
Each download can show its own progress window; closing it keeps the download in a small list at the bottom right
The video download button in the browser opens its own window instead of the main window
Browse buttons wherever a folder or file is asked for
New Other category for files that fit no other category
Option to catch every file type, with exceptions
New browser extension (2.5.1): video download button can be dragged anywhere and hidden per site; tidier menu
